auditor_kim: Hi all  quick list for tomorrow's SOC2 review: RBAC deltas (90d), proof of PR approvals, service-account deprovs (token invalidation), KMS key access tied to any changes, and vuln tickets mapping. Drop ETA?

maya_sec: We can produce CSV + one traced example (PR -> CI -> kube audit -> KMS event). Also short control-mapping note for SOC2 CC6.2 / ISO A.9.2.

rob_oncall: I'll export rolebinding diffs from infra-git and produce rolebinding_changes.csv with cols: pr, author, approver, cluster, binding, added, removed, jira_ticket. ETA 15:00 PT.

leo_infra: Splunk query I'll use for kube audit snippets:
```splunk
index=k8s_audit "RoleBinding" OR "ClusterRoleBinding" | where _time>=relative_time(now(), "-90d@d") | table _time user verb objectRef.name namespace requestID
```

leo_infra: For KMS (AWS) quick Athena query:
```sql
SELECT eventTime, eventName, userIdentity, requestParameters.keyId FROM cloudtrail WHERE eventName IN ('Encrypt','Decrypt','GenerateDataKey') AND eventTime >= date_add('day', -90, current_date)
```

maya_sec: For service-account deprovs we'll include last_active from auth-metrics and key deletion events (IAM). If rotated, note rotation ticket.

auditor_kim: Good. Please ensure timestamps are ISO8601 with timezone. We need PR URL + screenshot of approval for the traced example.

rob_oncall: Adding PR links + approval screenshot. Will create README.txt describing files and contacts (maya_sec primary).

cert-bot: evidence-uploaded evidence-bucket/engsec/2823456789_audit_bundle.zip (expires in 36h) :package:

maya_sec: Confirmed upload and emailed audit mailbox. I'll annotate the control mapping PDF showing which artifact satisfies which control clause.

auditor_kim: Thanks team  i'll review and post any follow-ups in this thread. :thumbsup:
